full_page.content:
1932, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 42 Cont.
June Mrs. Stefane Radzilowski - 22 - heart trouble and nerves - a year ago in hospital & given up by doctors - was enrolled in S.M.A. comes To-day with husband and is enrolled again.
Rose Farrons Mother very very sick
Anna Bittinger age - Enrolled(June 2nd) last Thursday waiting in Ford hospital for amputation of cancerus leg ..... Case very threat- ening & hopeless. Yesterday her adopted son reports apetite re- turned and pain gone. He enrolls her as perpetual member. To-day he phones.
Tory parents over 80 - one a Cath. daughter 60 never baptized, yet she prayes sometimes .....
Mrs. Clancey - 51 - paralysed
Blank Page
Page 43 Page 44 June 10 Cancer of Womb. Dela Anderson - 44 - of Crokville Tenn. - given up by doctors - failed to recognize anyone - does not remember of her son being home to see her middle of last month - Enrolled last Tues- day - three days ago - next day got up and had dinner at table.
Baby Yvonne, year old, bright, healthy otherwise but sadly weak in neck - cannot control its head.
Mrs. P. Mason - 53 - goiter - heart
June 9th Patricia Donahue - 4 - Tubercula maningitis - Dr's had given her up. Sunday .... Monday surprised. June 15 ... Dr. surprised - child quite improving ...
Thomas Fleming - 41 - dropsey - no doctor seems able to help. Mrs. Callins ... Heart - Rhumatism
Gertrude Whitterkin - nervous. .. has principal difficulties with perfumes ...
Mrs. Cunningham Mrs. Fortune - Chicago - dying of Cancer Dale Danielson - 6 - can only speak few words
